premise: Shrimp wonders how Seaweed stands tall in the water when everything else lies on the bottom; Seaweed shows her little air bubbles, lifting her to the sun.
inspiration: The 'why the reed bends' fables (Aesop's Oak and the Reed) turned into a wondering: what holds the soft thing up is air.
lesson: Each of us is held up by something.
learning: Seaweed has little air bubbles that help it float up towards the light.

en-US.title: Seaweed Reaches Up
en-US.text: [softly] {canvas:sunshine 0.6 25s} Morning sunshine poured into the rock pool. {seaweed:enter} Seaweed woke up and {seaweed:face happy} stretched towards it. {shrimp:enter} Shrimp watched, {shrimp:face surprised} puzzled. Shells lie down. Pebbles lie down. {clam:enter} {clam:pulse} Even Clam lies down on the bottom, all day long. [curious] Seaweed, how do you stand up in the water? [playfully] Look closely, said Seaweed. {seaweed:pulse} See my little round balls? {seaweed:sparkle} They're full of air, like tiny balloons. They lift me up, up, towards the sun. {seaweed:live hold} And she swayed up tall into the light. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:live} Shrimp twitched her feelers. Ooh, I want a balloon too! [short pause] {clam:live} Clam opened up, sleepily, and closed again. [laughs] I'll stay down here, thank you, she said. {clam:face sleeping} The bottom is very comfy. {shrimp:hearts} [warmly] And the three friends spent the whole morning, one tall, one small, one snoozing, in the sun.

es-ES.title: El alga que crece hacia arriba
es-ES.text: [softly] {canvas:sunshine 0.6 25s} El sol de la mañana entraba en la charca. {seaweed:enter} Alga se despertó y {seaweed:face happy} se estiró hacia él. {shrimp:enter} Gamba la miraba, {shrimp:face surprised} extrañada. Las conchas se tumban. Las piedras se tumban. {clam:enter} {clam:pulse} Hasta Almeja se queda tumbada en el fondo todo el día. [curious] Alga, ¿cómo te quedas de pie en el agua? [playfully] Fíjate bien, dijo Alga. {seaweed:pulse} ¿Ves mis bolitas redondas? {seaweed:sparkle} Están llenas de aire, como globitos. Me suben, arriba, arriba, hacia el sol. {seaweed:live hold} Y se meció, bien alta, hacia la luz. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:live} Gamba movió las antenas. ¡Yo también quiero un globito! [short pause] {clam:live} Almeja se abrió, medio dormida, y se volvió a cerrar. [laughs] Yo me quedo aquí abajo, gracias, dijo. {clam:face sleeping} El fondo es muy cómodo. {shrimp:hearts} [warmly] Y las tres amigas pasaron toda la mañana, una alta, una pequeña y una dormilona, al sol.

bubbles.prompt: tiny gentle bubbles rising in shallow clear water, close up, realistic
